name: Fomenko: Vymja razdora
source: Alexey Feoktistov is plagued by strange dreams, but how to sleep, when cows vanish in the native village of Fomenko?!?! It is time for him to step up and choose between love and justice, fear and bravery, rosemary and fennel. The picturesque characters, created taking into account the real rural experience, both popular and not really memes, a plot delivering on the one hand and scolding to the depths of the soul on the another one, wide opportunities of choice and, of course, a scar from salt on the right ball of the main character. All this is in Dandelion Coffee's first novel Fomenko: Contention Udder.
translation: 阿列克谢·费奥克蒂斯托夫 (Alexey Feoktistov) 被奇怪的梦所困扰，但是当奶牛在福缅科 (Fomenko) 的家乡消失时，如何入睡？！？！现在是他挺身而出，在爱与正义、恐惧与勇敢、迷迭香与茴香之间做出选择的时候了。风景如画的人物，考虑到真实的农村经历，既流行又不是真正的模因，一方面传达了一个情节，另一方面又责骂到灵魂深处，有广泛的选择机会，当然，还有主角右球上的盐伤疤。这一切都在蒲公英咖啡的第一部小说《福缅科：争夺乳房》中。
